status: Proposed living doctrine; not a membership contract or rank grant

orders.title: The Living Jedi Testament
commitments: Protect the freedom of students to disagree.
orders.oath: I choose awareness over haste, understanding over certainty, and service without possession. I accept responsibility for my actions and remain willing to learn.
orders.leadership: Teachers demonstrate knowledge, patience, accountability and respect for independent judgment.

orders.title: The Sith Flame
orders.tagline: Master yourself, and no throne is necessary.
commitments: Defend personal sovereignty while respecting the sovereignty of others.
orders.oath: I choose to shape my life through deliberate will. I shall examine my passions, confront my limitations and accept the consequences of my choices. My strength shall not require another's captivity.
orders.leadership: Teachers demonstrate competence, discipline, transparency and respect for voluntary participation.

shared.title: The Covenant of Two Orders
shared.tagline: Two Orders. Eight Masters. One Grand Holocron.
principles: No oath overrides personal autonomy or applicable law.
Disagreement between Orders is not grounds for harassment.
Teachers disclose uncertainty and distinguish fiction from original spiritual doctrine.
Leadership decisions should be explainable and subject to review.

ceremonies.title: Crossing the Threshold
ceremonies.purpose: Welcome new participants without requiring an oath.
steps: Explain the Order's principles and voluntary nature.
Invite the participant to identify a personal learning goal.
Offer a private reflection or optional public introduction.

ceremonies.title: Recognition of Learning
ceremonies.purpose: Celebrate demonstrated learning without automatic rank advancement.
steps: Invite the learner to describe a completed study or practice.
Offer specific feedback and acknowledge limitations.

ceremonies.title: Returning to the Path
ceremonies.purpose: Welcome participants after an absence without punishment.
steps: Ask what support the participant wants.
Agree on a manageable next step.
Allow the participant to decline any ceremony.
